note: Twilio publishes no formal support window for server-side helper libraries. Since 2022-2024 every library is generated from twilio-oai, and most recent majors say there are no breaking API changes; the breaking parts are runtime minimums and a few renamed classes. Each library also ships minor releases roughly every two weeks with API additions (see CHANGES.md).

breaking: Minimum Node.js raised to 20 (dropped < 20). No API changes per the upgrade guide.

Node.js >= 14 required.
Lazy loading of modules on by default.
Some response properties typed as Record<string, ...> instead of object (subresourceUris, links).
AccessToken requires an identity option; IpMessagingGrant removed; ConversationsGrant deprecated in favour of VoiceGrant.
TwiML: Say.ssmlX() helpers replaced by Say.x() (e.g. ssmlEmphasis -> emphasis, ssmlBreak/break_ -> break); Refer.referSip -> Refer.sip.
TaskRouter Workers cumulativeStatistics()/realTimeStatistics() moved from workers('WK..') to workers (no WorkerSid).
Old line; Node 3.x-era code often uses require('twilio')(sid, token) which still works, but 3.x itself is long unsupported.

notes: 5.x/6.x CHANGES list 'Token pagination support' (PR #1162) and response headers support (PR #1167).

Ground-up redesign (first-class paging and streaming, swappable HTTP client, domain/version accessors such as @client.chat.v2). 4.x code needs rewriting.
5.3: Chat Message create takes from first and body: as keyword (Body no longer required).
Generated from OpenAPI; upgrade guide says no breaking changes to existing APIs. Adds application/json request bodies. README lists PHP 8.2-8.4 as supported.
Generated from OpenAPI; upgrade guide says no breaking changes.
Drops PHP 5.5-7.1; adds scalar parameter and return types, so a TypeError may be thrown for incompatible arguments.

Generated class names for nested models/enums now keep digits from schema names, e.g. Conversation.ConversationsVConversationGroupingType -> ConversationsV2ConversationGroupingType (conversations.v2 Action/Communication/Configuration/Conversation/Operation/Participant, messaging.v2 ChannelsSender).
Non-breaking: nested response models ignore unknown fields (no more UnrecognizedPropertyException on new API fields).

io.jsonwebtoken SignatureAlgorithm replaced by SecureDigestAlgorithm (Jwts.SIG.RS256/PS256) in Jwt, ValidationClient, ValidationInterceptor, ValidationToken. Only affects code passing an explicit algorithm or subclassing Jwt.
JDK 21 build support; compiled JAR stays JDK 8 compatible.
NetworkHttpClient moved from Apache HttpClient 4 to HttpClient 5 (affects custom HTTP clients).
Organizations API auth init changed; enum suffix fix (StatusEnum -> Status) in Organizations Account.
anyType fields now typed Object instead of Map<String,Object>.

clientSdks.note: Programmable Chat client SDK. Chat is deprecated and receives no support; move to the Conversations client SDK (@twilio/conversations).
Conversations (classic) client SDKs: JavaScript 2.x is Latest and 1.x is EOL; iOS 4.x Latest; Android 6.x Latest. Previous majors get 12 months of fixes, then 12 months deprecated, then EOL.
Programmable Video client SDKs. Video is NOT end-of-life: the 2024 EOL plan was reversed on 2024-10-21. Check the Video changelog for the current SDK major.
Authy API client libraries. Authy API is at End of Support and closed to new customers; migrate to Verify v2 via the main twilio helper library (client.verify.v2).
